# redmoon

[![DeepWiki](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepWiki-Omochice%2Fredmoon-blue.svg?logo=data:image/png;base64,)](https://deepwiki.com/Omochice/redmoon)<!-- DeepWiki badge generated by https://deepwiki.ryoppippi.com/ -->
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.scorecard.dev/projects/github.com/Omochice/redmoon/badge)](https://scorecard.dev/viewer/?uri=github.com/Omochice/redmoon)

A [Redmine](https://www.redmine.org/) MCP server written in MoonBit.

The API key is kept in the OS keyring rather than in the MCP client's configuration, so it never appears in an argument list and `env` or `cat` etc.

## Usage

Prebuilt binaries for `aarch64-apple-darwin` and `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu` are attached to each [release](https://github.com/Omochice/redmoon/releases).

### login

`login` prompts for the key of an endpoint and stores it.

```console
$ redmoon login --endpoint https://redmine.example.com
Redmine API key:
Stored API key for https://redmine.example.com.
```

### serve

The MCP client then runs `serve` over stdio.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "redmine": {
      "type": "stdio",
      "command": "redmoon",
      "args": ["serve", "--endpoint", "https://redmine.example.com"]
    }
  }
}
```

`--readonly` drops every create, update, and delete action.
`--plugin issue_templates` adds the tools of the [redmine_issue_templates](https://github.com/agileware-jp/redmine_issue_templates) plugin.
`redmoon serve --help` lists every option.

### logout

`logout` deletes the stored key of an endpoint.

```console
$ redmoon logout --endpoint https://redmine.example.com
Removed API key for https://redmine.example.com.
```

### list

`list` prints the endpoints that have a stored key, one per line.

```console
$ redmoon list
https://redmine.example.com
```
